title: Akiyama Mizuki — Summer Night Festival〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How's this...?!
No, I missed...! I can't hit anything...!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You're an awful shot, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, she even got the toughest one! Why didn't you tell us you were so good at this, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not. This is my first time.
It's easy. Just point and shoot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that wasn't directed at me, was it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? You have to pull this trigger pretty hard, huh...? I can't hit anything, and this thing's heavier than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, since we're all here, wanna check out the rest of the festival together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really thought I was having fun then...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So why is it that it feels like there's this great big hold in my heart...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki here♪
What's up, teach?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? I have to go in for supplementary classes again? I could've sworn that I showed up enough this time to not have to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hold on, tomorrow...?!
But tomorrow's Sun...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go. I'm sorry for making you waste your day off like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But there's nothing to do here either. I guess school wins by default...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I left early to make sure I get to school in time, but man, this is such a pain...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I'll take a little detour while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Nooo! It's too early!
Nothing's open yet!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess I'll just go kill some time at the bookstore...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, good morning.
You're in your uniform... Are you on your way to school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, they're making me take supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
How about you?
What brings you here so early? Without Li'l Bro too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's not like I'm always with Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We actually just finished our morning practice and have some free time now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, well... It should take place in the morning, no...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You guys must really love singing if you're willing to get up this early to practice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm hardly ever at school, so we haven't really talked much but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I never knew he could smile and laugh like this.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And as you already know, Akito, my dad has been teaching me classical music since I was only a few years old.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He made me practice before going to school and after coming home until it was time for bed. On weekends, I had to spend the entire day playing the piano and violin.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the time I started middle school, I couldn't stand it anymore. I started thinking about finding a way out...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I still don't know Toya's whole story, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's great that you found something you really love doing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, thanks to Akito and the others, I was able to talk to my dad about what I'm doing now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before, every time I went home, we always ended up fighting and arguing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't find the opportunity to tell him how I really felt...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But my teammates managed to open that door for me, and I was finally able to talk to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I even asked him to come to see us perform.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After that, well... He's still more or less stone-faced, but we don't fight anymore...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad that I can pursue the path I actually want to now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I was happy that I was able to get him to understand that I have a dream and not care if he doesn't approve of it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They fought and argued that much, but he still had the guts to face his dad and tell him how he really felt.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He never gave up on what he loves doing and actually got through to his dad...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's just, I was wondering what it is that you like to do is all, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've gotten to know each other a little better, but we haven't really talked about our hobbies, dreams and such until now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I'd like to stay and chat a little longer, but I gotta get to class soon...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Sorry for keeping you like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it's totally okay. I was the one that started asking a bunch of questions first, so... Later!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Talk about bailing out there. I doubt Toya isn't bothered by it, but that was pretty lame of me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But we were talking about hobbies and stuff so... Why didn't I just say that I like designing clothes or something like that?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, that might've just gone over his head...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, he has nothing to hide and just lets everything out into the open...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like... I was almost at the point of wanting to speak the truth too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, pull yourself together!
Get your butt to school already!
